bug_report:
Sprintf1 repeats the entire format string if it starts with a directive
Createdattachment 61184[details]test case prog.mod

The result of Sprintf1 is not right, when passed a format string that starts with a directive.

How to reproduce:
$ gm2 prog.mod
$ ./a.out

Expected output:
---------------------------------------------


        17
%u pieces of cake

        16
2 pieces of cake

        17
%u pieces of cake

---------------------------------------------

Actual output:
---------------------------------------------


        17
%u pieces of cake

        33
%u pieces of cake2 pieces of cake

        17
%u pieces of cake

---------------------------------------------

Seen with gm2 (GCC) 15.0.1 20250323 (experimental).
